entries: On its turn, the ship's AI may take one action (Proficiency Bonus of +6) granted by an installed modification. It may take bonus actions granted by modifications. It has advantage on Intelligence (Astrogation) checks. It may take reactions granted by modifications. It may take any standard action, including {@action Fire|sw5e-sotg} (proficient with ship weapons) and {@action Helm|sw5e-sotg} at the helm. The AI is proficient in {@skill Piloting|sw5e-phb} and can move the ship during combat. When the AI takes the {@action Interfere|sw5e-sotg} action, it has advantage on the Charisma (Interfere) check. The AI has expertise in {@skill Piloting|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: {@i Threat Tracker}
entries: When the ship would make a Dexterity saving throw, it can instead make a Wisdom saving throw. Uses equal to the ship's Wisdom modifier; regained when the ship recharges.

entries.name: {@i Concentrated Fire}
entries: Once per turn, when attacking a Large or larger ship previously hit by an allied Large or larger ship since the end of its last turn, gain advantage on the attack (or reroll one advantage die).

entries.name: {@i Reinforced armor}
entries: This ship has disadvantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb}) checks.

other.name: Actions​

entries.name: {@b {@i Heavy ion cannon (×2)}}
entries: Facing: Front. {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit (or 2 + the operator's Proficiency Bonus), range 1000/4000 ft., one target. {@i Hit:} 7 ({@damage 1d10+2}) ion damage. {@i Ionizing:} On a hit, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or it is ionized for 1 minute. As an action on each of the ship's turns, a crewmember can repeat the save, ending the effect on a success. Ships larger than you have advantage on the save. {@i Heat cost:} 1. {@i {@itemProperty STOHT|sw5e-sotg|Overheat}}: 4.

entries.name: {@b {@i Turbolaser (×2)}}
entries: Facing: 360° (Turret). {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit (or 2 + the operator's Proficiency Bonus), range 1000/4000 ft., one target. {@i Hit:} 7 ({@damage 1d10+2}) energy damage. {@i Heat cost:} 1. {@i {@itemProperty STOHT|sw5e-sotg|Overheat}}: 4.

entries.name: {@b {@i Missile launcher, Burst (×4)}}
entries: Facing: Front. {@i Dexterity Saving Throw:} {@dc 12} (or 10 + the operator's Proficiency Bonus), every ship in a 150-foot cube within range (600/2400). {@i Failure:} 9 ({@damage 2d8}) energy damage. {@i Success:} Half damage. {@i Explosive:} Creatures inside affected ships must succeed on a Constitution saving throw to maintain concentration. {@i Ammo cost:} 1. {@i {@itemProperty STRLD|sw5e-sotg|Reload}}: 4.

entries.name: {@b {@i Missile launcher, Rapid (×4)}}

entries.name: {@i Sensor Dampener}

entries.name: {@i Blockade Runner}
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack roll from a Large or larger ship, a crewmember at the helm can use their reaction to immediately move the ship forward an amount equal to half its flying speed (rounded down) and then roll a Blockade Runner die, which is a {@dice d6}, and subtract it from the triggering attack roll, potentially causing it to miss.

entries.name: {@i S-Foils}
entries.entry: As a bonus action, a crewmember can switch between Locked (+50 ft. speed, −2 penalty to primary weapon attack rolls) and Unlocked (+1 bonus to primary weapon attack rolls). This statblock assumes Unlocked.

entries.name: {@i Patch}
entries.entry: A crewmember can take the {@action Patch|sw5e-sotg} action as a bonus action.

entries.name: {@i Pinpoint Strike}
entries: When your ship occupies the same square occupied by a target ship and the crewmember at the helm makes an attack roll, as a reaction, they can, before rolling the attack, roll a Pinpoint Strike die, which is a {@dice d6}, and add it to the attack roll.  If the attack requires a saving throw instead, you may subtract the Pinpoint Strike die from the target's save result.  On a hit or a failed save, the attack deals normal damage that bypasses any shields and directly hits the hull of the target ship. This feature can only be used once per round.
This feature can be used 2 times. All expended uses are regained when the ship recharges.

entries.name: {@i Retro Thrusters}
entries: When an attacker that a crewmember can see deals damage to your ship with a weapon, they can use their reaction to immediately move the ship up to 50 feet in a direction of their choice, halving the damage your ship takes. The orientation of the ship does not change.
Once this feature has been used, it can't be used again until the ship recharges.

entries.name: {@i Standard Actions}
entries: {@action Boost|sw5e-sotg}, {@action Detect|sw5e-sotg}, {@action Direct|sw5e-sotg}, {@action Fire|sw5e-sotg}, {@action Helm|sw5e-sotg}, {@action Interfere|sw5e-sotg}, {@action Patch|sw5e-sotg}, {@action Regenerate Shields|sw5e-sotg}.
{@note On the ship's turn, each crewmember may take one action (limited to their deployment, station, class, ventures, equipment). Only the helm crewmember can take Helm actions.}

entries.name: {@i Pinpoint Strike}
entries: When your ship occupies the same square occupied by a target ship and the crewmember at the helm makes an attack roll, as a reaction, they can, before rolling the attack, roll a Pinpoint Strike die, which is a {@dice d8}, and add it to the attack roll.  If the attack requires a saving throw instead, you may subtract the Pinpoint Strike die from the target's save result.  On a hit or a failed save, the attack deals normal damage that bypasses any shields and directly hits the hull of the target ship. This feature can only be used once per round.
This feature can be used 3 times. All expended uses are regained when the ship recharges.

entries.name: {@i Retro Thrusters}
entries: When an attacker that a crewmember can see deals damage to your ship with a weapon, they can use their reaction to immediately move the ship up to 50 feet in a direction of their choice, halving the damage your ship takes. The orientation of the ship does not change.
Once this feature has been used, it can't be used again until the ship recharges.

entries.name: {@i Versatile Snubfighter}
entries: When a crewmember makes, with the ship, an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw, they can use their reaction to have advantage on the roll. A crewmember can choose to use this feature after they make their roll, but before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails.
This feature can be used a number of times equal to your ship's tier. All expended uses are regained when the ship is refitted.

entries.name: {@i Adaptive Ailerons}
entries: While in atmosphere, turn speed decreases by 100 ft. (min. 50 ft.), and the ship has +1 AC and +1 to Dexterity saving throws.

entries.name: {@i Threat Tracker}
entries: When the ship would make a Dexterity saving throw, it can instead make a Wisdom saving throw. Uses equal to the ship's Wisdom modifier; regained when the ship recharges.

entries.name: {@i Evasive Maneuvers}
entries: When a crewmember at the helm rolls for initiative, they can immediately move the ship before initiative order is determined (Evasive Maneuvers die × 50 ft.). Uses equal to 2× the ship's tier; regained when the ship is refitted.

entries.name: {@i Nimble Starship}
entries: The ship adds half its Dexterity modifier (minimum of one) to any saving throw it makes that doesn't already include that modifier.

entries.name: {@i Reinforced armor}
entries: This ship has disadvantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb}) checks.

entries.name: {@i Emergency Generator (Restore Shields)}
entries: If the ship has 0 {@variantrule Shield Points|sw5e-sotg|shield points}, a crewmember can use their action to restore {@variantrule Shield Points|sw5e-sotg|shield points} equal to twice the ship's strength modifier. Once used, the emergency generator can't be used again until the ship recharges.

entries.name: {@i Sensor Dampener}
entries: As an action, a crewmember can attempt to dampen the sensors of a ship they can see within 1,000 feet.

entries.name: {@i Patch}

entries.name: {@i Countermeasures}
entries.entry: Once per round, when your ship is forced to make a saving throw against an effect that would cause it to be {@condition Blinded|sw5e-phb|blinded}, ionized, {@condition Shocked|sw5e-phb|shocked}, stalled, {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb|stunned}, or tractored a crewmember can use their reaction to add the ship's Wisdom modifier to the roll (minimum of +1).

entries.name: {@i Emergency Generator}
entries.entry: When your ship is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Shield Points|sw5e-sotg|shield points} but not destroyed outright, a crewmember can use their reaction to have it drop to 1 shield point instead.

If the attack requires a saving throw instead, you may subtract the Pinpoint Strike die from the target's save result.  On a hit or a failed save, the attack deals normal damage that bypasses any shields and directly hits the hull of the target ship. This feature can only be used once per round.
This feature can be used 2 times. All expended uses are regained when the ship recharges.

entries.name: {@i Retro Thrusters}
entries: When an attacker that a crewmember can see deals damage to your ship with a weapon, they can use their reaction to immediately move the ship up to 50 feet in a direction of their choice, halving the damage your ship takes. The orientation of the ship does not change.
Once this feature has been used, it can't be used again until the ship recharges.

entries.name: {@i Super-Heavy Ion Cannon}
entries: A crewmember can fire the super-heavy {@item Ion cannon|sw5e-sotg} at a target as an action (range 1,000 ft., limited {@variantrule Firing Arc|sw5e-sotg|firing arc}). The target must make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + the crewmember's Proficiency Bonus + the ship's Strength modifier). On a failed save, the target is {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb|stunned} for 1 minute. As an action on each of the ship's turns, a crewmember can repeat the save, ending the effect on a success. If the target is two or more sizes larger, it has disadvantage on the initial save; if two or more sizes smaller, advantage. Uses equal to the ship's tier (minimum once); all expended uses are regained when the ship recharges.

Once used, the emergency generator can't be used again until the ship recharges.

entries: Crew minimum and maximum become 0; the droid brain controls the ship (Proficiency Bonus +3, proficient in {@skill Piloting|sw5e-phb}). In combat, the droid brain rolls its own initiative and can move the ship. It can take 2 actions per turn (half its Proficiency Bonus of +3, rounded up), plus bonus actions and reactions. It has advantage on initiative rolls.

entries.name: {@i Inertial Dampeners}
entries: When you are forced to make a concentration check due to damage, impacts, or explosions exterior to the ship, you have advantage. When you take the {@action Evade|sw5e-sotg} action, skill checks and attack rolls made by your ship or anyone on it do not suffer from disadvantage from the evasion. Once this feature has been used for the evasion benefit, it can't be used again until the ship recharges.

entries.entry: When the ship fires the Rapid-fire laser cannon as an action, it can fire a linked weapon in the same firing arc as a bonus action.

entries.name: {@i Pinpoint Strike}
entries: When your ship occupies the same square occupied by a target ship and the crewmember at the helm makes an attack roll, as a reaction, they can, before rolling the attack, roll a Pinpoint Strike die, which is a {@dice d6}, and add it to the attack roll.  If the attack requires a saving throw instead, you may subtract the Pinpoint Strike die from the target's save result.  On a hit or a failed save, the attack deals normal damage that bypasses any shields and directly hits the hull of the target ship. This feature can only be used once per round.
This feature can be used 2 times. All expended uses are regained when the ship recharges.

entries.name: {@i Retro Thrusters}
entries: When an attacker that a crewmember can see deals damage to your ship with a weapon, they can use their reaction to immediately move the ship up to 50 feet in a direction of their choice, halving the damage your ship takes. The orientation of the ship does not change.
Once this feature has been used, it can't be used again until the ship recharges.

entries.name: {@i Inertial Dampeners}
entries: When you are forced to make a concentration check due to damage, impacts, or explosions exterior to the ship, you have advantage. When you take the {@action Evade|sw5e-sotg} action, skill checks and attack rolls made by your ship or anyone on it do not suffer from disadvantage from the evasion. Once this feature has been used for the evasion benefit, it can't be used again until the ship recharges.

entries.name: {@i Evasive Maneuvers}
entries: When a crewmember at the helm rolls for initiative, they can immediately move the ship before initiative order is determined (Evasive Maneuvers die × 50 ft.). Uses equal to 2× the ship's tier; regained when the ship is refitted.

entries.name: {@i Nimble Starship}
entries: The ship adds half its Dexterity modifier (minimum of one) to any saving throw it makes that doesn't already include that modifier.

entries.name: {@i Pinpoint Strike}
entries: When your ship occupies the same square occupied by a target ship and the crewmember at the helm makes an attack roll, as a reaction, they can, before rolling the attack, roll a Pinpoint Strike die, which is a {@dice d6}, and add it to the attack roll.  If the attack requires a saving throw instead, you may subtract the Pinpoint Strike die from the target's save result.  On a hit or a failed save, the attack deals normal damage that bypasses any shields and directly hits the hull of the target ship. This feature can only be used once per round.
This feature can be used 2 times. All expended uses are regained when the ship recharges.

entries.name: {@i Retro Thrusters}
entries: When an attacker that a crewmember can see deals damage to your ship with a weapon, they can use their reaction to immediately move the ship up to 50 feet in a direction of their choice, halving the damage your ship takes. The orientation of the ship does not change.
Once this feature has been used, it can't be used again until the ship recharges.

entries.name: {@i Blockade Runner}
entries: As a reaction to being hit with an attack roll from a Large or larger ship, a crewmember at the helm can use their reaction to immediately move the ship forward an amount equal to half its flying speed (rounded down) and then roll a Blockade Runner die, which is a {@dice d12}, and subtract it from the triggering attack roll, potentially causing it to miss.
This feature can be used 15 times. All expended uses are regained when the ship is refitted.

entries.name: {@i Versatile Frigate}

This feature can be used 15 times. All expended uses are regained when the ship is refitted.

entries: When your ship occupies the same square occupied by a target ship and the crewmember at the helm makes an attack roll, as a reaction, they can, before rolling the attack, roll a Pinpoint Strike die, which is a {@dice d4}, and add it to the attack roll.  If the attack requires a saving throw instead, you may subtract the Pinpoint Strike die from the target's save result. entries: When an attacker that a crewmember can see deals damage to your ship with a weapon, they can use their reaction to immediately move the ship up to 50 feet in a direction of their choice, halving the damage your ship takes. The orientation of the ship does not change.
Once this feature has been used, it can't be used again until the ship recharges.

entries.name: {@i Versatile Snubfighter}
entries: When a crewmember makes, with the ship, an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw, they can use their reaction to have advantage on the roll. A crewmember can choose to use this feature after they make their roll, but before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails.
This feature can be used a number of times equal to your ship's tier. All expended uses are regained when the ship is refitted.

entries.name: {@i Flare Pods}
entries.entry: When your ship is forced to make a Dexterity saving throw, a crewmember can use their reaction to release a flare.

entries.name: {@i Countermeasures}
entries.entry: Once per round, when your ship is forced to make a saving throw against an effect that would cause it to be {@condition Blinded|sw5e-phb|blinded}, ionized, {@condition Shocked|sw5e-phb|shocked}, stalled, {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb|stunned}, or tractored a crewmember can use their reaction to add the ship's Wisdom modifier to the roll (minimum of +1).

entries.name: {@i Inertial Dampeners}
entries: When you are forced to make a concentration check due to damage, impacts, or explosions exterior to the ship, you have advantage. When you take the {@action Evade|sw5e-sotg} action, skill checks and attack rolls made by your ship or anyone on it do not suffer from disadvantage from the evasion. Once this feature has been used for the evasion benefit, it can't be used again until the ship recharges.

entries.name: {@i Threat Tracker}
entries: When the ship would make a Dexterity saving throw, it can instead make a Wisdom saving throw. Uses equal to the ship's Wisdom modifier; regained when the ship recharges.

entries.name: {@i Reinforced armor}
entries: This ship has disadvantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb}) checks.

other.name: Actions​

entries.name: {@b {@i Heavy laser cannon (×1)}}
entries: Facing: Front. {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit (or 2 + the operator's Proficiency Bonus), range 1200/4800 ft., one target. {@i Hit:} 10 ({@damage 1d12+4}) energy damage. {@i Direct Controller:} The operator may use their Dexterity modifier instead of the ship's Wisdom modifier for this weapon's attack rolls or save DC. {@i Heat cost:} 1. {@i {@itemProperty STOHT|sw5e-sotg|Overheat}}: 2.

entries.name: {@b {@i Twin auto-blaster, Burst (×1)}}
entries: Facing: Front. {@i Dexterity Saving Throw:} {@dc 14} (or 11 + the operator's Proficiency Bonus), every ship in a 150-foot cube within range (250/1000). {@i Failure:} 6 ({@damage 1d4+4}) energy damage. {@i Success:} No damage. {@i Heat cost:} 10. {@i {@itemProperty STOHT|sw5e-sotg|Overheat}}: 20.

entries.name: {@b {@i Twin auto-blaster, Rapid (×1)}}
entries: Facing: Front. {@i Dexterity Saving Throw:} {@dc 14} (or 11 + the operator's Proficiency Bonus), one ship within range (250/1000). {@i Failure:} 9 ({@damage 2d4+4}) energy damage. {@i Success:} No damage. {@i Heat cost:} 5. {@i {@itemProperty STOHT|sw5e-sotg|Overheat}}: 20.

entries.name: {@b {@i Ion cannon (×1)}}
entries: Facing: Front. {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit (or 4 + the operator's Proficiency Bonus), range 800/3200 ft., one target. {@i Hit:} 9 ({@damage 2d4+4}) ion damage. {@i Ionizing:} On a hit, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or it is ionized for 1 minute. As an action on each of the ship's turns, a crewmember can repeat the save, ending the effect on a success. Ships larger than you have advantage on the save. {@i Heat cost:} 1. {@i {@itemProperty STOHT|sw5e-sotg|Overheat}}: 8.

entries.name: {@b {@i Torpedo launcher (×2)}}
entries: Facing: Front. {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit (or 3 + the operator's Proficiency Bonus), range 1200/4800 ft., one target. {@i Hit:} 11 ({@damage 2d10}) energy damage. {@i Explosive:} On a hit, creatures inside the target ship must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (DC 10 or half the damage dealt, whichever is higher) to maintain concentration. {@i Keen 1:} {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|Critical hit range} increases by 1. {@i Ammo cost:} 1. {@i {@itemProperty STRLD|sw5e-sotg|Reload}}: 4.

entries.name: {@i Standard Actions}
entries: {@action Boost|sw5e-sotg}, {@action Detect|sw5e-sotg}, {@action Direct|sw5e-sotg}, {@action Fire|sw5e-sotg}, {@action Helm|sw5e-sotg}, {@action Interfere|sw5e-sotg}, {@action Patch|sw5e-sotg}, {@action Regenerate Shields|sw5e-sotg}.
{@note On the ship's turn, each crewmember may take one action (limited to their deployment, station, class, ventures, equipment). Only the helm crewmember can take Helm actions.}

entries.name: {@i Flight Computer}
entries.entry: Once per round, a crewmember at the helm can take {@action Fly|sw5e-sotg} or {@action Evade|sw5e-sotg} as a bonus action, or a crewmember can take {@action Regenerate Shields|sw5e-sotg} as a bonus action.

entries.name: {@i S-Foils}
entries.entry: As a bonus action, a crewmember can switch between Locked (+50 ft. speed, −2 penalty to primary weapon attack rolls) and Unlocked (+1 bonus to primary weapon attack rolls). This statblock assumes Unlocked.

entries.name: {@i Navcomputer}
entries.entry: A crewmember can use a bonus action to make an Intelligence (Astrogation) check.

entries.name: {@i Fire-linked Heavy laser cannon}
entries.entry: When the ship fires the Heavy laser cannon as an action, it can fire its Twin auto-blaster, Ion cannon, or Torpedo launcher as a bonus action.

entries.name: {@i Fire-linked Twin auto-blaster}
entries.entry: When the ship fires the Twin auto-blaster as an action, it can fire its Heavy laser cannon, Ion cannon, or Torpedo launcher as a bonus action.

entries.name: {@i Pinpoint Strike}
entries: When your ship occupies the same square occupied by a target ship and the crewmember at the helm makes an attack roll, as a reaction, they can, before rolling the attack, roll a Pinpoint Strike die, which is a {@dice d8}, and add it to the attack roll.  If the attack requires a saving throw instead, you may subtract the Pinpoint Strike die from the target's save result.  On a hit or a failed save, the attack deals normal damage that bypasses any shields and directly hits the hull of the target ship. This feature can only be used once per round.
This feature can be used 3 times. All expended uses are regained when the ship recharges.

entries.name: {@i Retro Thrusters}
entries: When an attacker that a crewmember can see deals damage to your ship with a weapon, they can use their reaction to immediately move the ship up to 50 feet in a direction of their choice, halving the damage your ship takes. The orientation of the ship does not change.
Once this feature has been used, it can't be used again until the ship recharges.

entries.name: {@i Versatile Snubfighter}
entries: When a crewmember makes, with the ship, an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw, they can use their reaction to have advantage on the roll. A crewmember can choose to use this feature after they make their roll, but before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails.
This feature can be used a number of times equal to your ship's tier. All expended uses are regained when the ship is refitted.

entries.name: {@i Countermeasures}
entries.entry: Once per round, when your ship is forced to make a saving throw against an effect that would cause it to be {@condition Blinded|sw5e-phb|blinded}, ionized, {@condition Shocked|sw5e-phb|shocked}, stalled, {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb|stunned}, or tractored a crewmember can use their reaction to add the ship's Wisdom modifier to the roll (minimum of +1).

entries.name: {@i Ejection Pod}
entries.entry: When your ship is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hull Points|sw5e-sotg|hull points} but not destroyed outright, you can use your reaction to eject the pod from the ship.

entries: When your ship occupies the same square occupied by a target ship and the crewmember at the helm makes an attack roll, as a reaction, they can, before rolling the attack, roll a Pinpoint Strike die, which is a {@dice d10}, and add it to the attack roll.  If the attack requires a saving throw instead, you may subtract the Pinpoint Strike die from the target's save result.  On a hit or a failed save, the attack deals normal damage that bypasses any shields and directly hits the hull of the target ship. This feature can only be used once per round.
This feature can be used 4 times. All expended uses are regained when the ship recharges.

entries.name: {@i Retro Thrusters}
entries: When an attacker that a crewmember can see deals damage to your ship with a weapon, they can use their reaction to immediately move the ship up to 50 feet in a direction of their choice, halving the damage your ship takes. The orientation of the ship does not change.
Once this feature has been used, it can't be used again until the ship recharges.

entries.name: {@i Versatile Snubfighter}
entries: When a crewmember makes, with the ship, an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw, they can use their reaction to have advantage on the roll. A crewmember can choose to use this feature after they make their roll, but before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails.
This feature can be used a number of times equal to your ship's tier. All expended uses are regained when the ship is refitted.

entries: As an action, a crewmember can activate the tractor beam (range 600 ft., limited {@variantrule Firing Arc|sw5e-sotg|firing arc}). Each ship or object of your size or smaller in the arc must make a Strength saving throw (DC = 8 + ship tier + the ship's Strength modifier). On a failed save, a ship is {@condition Tractored|sw5e-sotg|tractored}. An object automatically fails. As a bonus action, a crewmember can move a tractored ship or object (50–200 ft. based on relative size). Uses equal to the ship's tier (minimum once); all expended uses are regained when the ship recharges.
